meaning:
1) agitation, excitement, raging, trouble, turmoil, trembling
1a) turmoil, disquiet, raging
1b) trembling, trepidation

elsewhere.note: There the wicked cease from troubling. There the weary are at rest.
It will happen in the day that Yahweh will give you rest from your sorrow, from your trouble, and from the hard service in which you were made to serve,
Yahweh, I have heard of your fame. I stand in awe of your deeds, Yahweh. Renew your work in the middle of the years. In the middle of the years make it known.…
